summary: Demo-yield regression: 20/25 unique backend cases passed after one rounding-sensitive retry; five retained failures identify three underlying issues. 66/66 dashboard UI checks plus mobile Ahoy visibility, History navigation, DayBalance source/overflow at both widths and return navigation passed. No observed public API 500, runtime exception or settled layout regression at 1920x800 and 390x844. Production code was not modified.

critical.issue: PV counters reset 69 seconds before UTC midnight. On 2026-06-21 default location, 23:58:50 counters sum to 14.774 kWh per PV device; at 23:58:51 all six channel/MPPT counters become 0. This violates same-day monotonicity and constant-after-sunset requirements. Reproduced at method level, not by changing the live server clock.

HTTP response day_energy_kwh=4.56 and total_energy_kwh=1234.5 are discarded. The adapter returns neither field; it also omits target_w, making TruckiCard hide its entire energy section. MQTT energy pass-through works. Adapter test uses isolated HTTP fixture; physical hardware was not accessed.

minor.issue: When intensity is omitted, live power calls _sun_curve(now) without supplied lat/lon although counters use them. Ahoy at June 21 07:00 UTC, lat=40/lon=-100 produces 954.2 W instead of 0 W with random jitter disabled. collect_live supplies the correct explicit intensity, so the public collection path avoids this mismatch.

design_issues.screen: Ahoy channel table and Trucki total
issues: Ahoy YDay column has no kWh unit in header or cells; Trucki GESAMT likewise lacks a unit. Victron and Trucki TAG correctly state kWh.

Preserve real Trucki HTTP energy and display fields without replacing them with demo computation.
Pass lat/lon to _sun_curve when mock functions calculate their own intensity.
Label Ahoy YDay and Trucki total energy in kWh.
Review non-demo failed-device fallback: collect_live currently generates MOCKED counters outside explicit demo mode, albeit marked online=false/_fallback=true.
Make the legacy autarky test account for uncertainty from independently rounded 0.001-kWh API energies; do not change correct application ratios to satisfy a rounding-sensitive assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: sun.py:38-39 calculates n=round(jd-2451545.0+0.0008), shifting the day at 23:58:50.88 UTC. mocks._solar_hours_today then compares now against tomorrow's sunrise and returns zero.
collectors.py:90-102 explicitly builds a Trucki dictionary that drops energy fields. This is pre-existing adapter behavior, not demonstrated as a newly introduced change.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use frontend/.env public URL and PYTHONPATH=/app/backend. Five retained failures: three late-night PV tests, direct-location power test and Trucki HTTP adapter test. All actual public polling stayed nondecreasing at approximately 00:26 UTC, legitimately zero PV after midnight. Whole-day five-minute samples initially missed the 69-second boundary; final sweep explicitly includes 23:59. UI runner executes namespace={}; exec(compile(open('/app/tests/demo_yield_ui_regression.py').read(), 'demo_yield_ui_regression.py', 'exec'), namespace); await namespace['run'](page). First UI harness mistakenly ignored /api/today?day_offset=0, failed after eight counter checks; corrected URL matching yielded 66/66. First immediate-scroll screenshot caught reveal animation; 900ms settled retest shows Ahoy correctly. Hardware integration tested through adapters only. Relevant backend logs showed normal startup/hot reload, no runtime exceptions. June afternoon integration is approximately 14.774 kWh for each 1.4-kW array, consistent with the simulated sine curve. Trucki integral, exact midnight reset and monotonic total across midnight passed.
rca of the issue: PV early reset: Julian-day rounding includes fractional clock time plus 0.0008 days; n advances 69.12 seconds before midnight, sun_times selects tomorrow, solar_hours_today returns 0 because now precedes tomorrow's sunrise. Normalize solar event calculation to a stable calendar-date anchor. Trucki HTTP omission: dictionary projection lists only power/SoC/switch fields, excluding source counters and target_w. Direct location mismatch: mock power calls omit lat/lon while integrated counter calls include them.
